Anthropic Proposes $1B Loss or 50-Casualty Threshold for AI Intervention According to POLITICO, Anthropic has been pitching U.S. lawmakers on an unpublished draft bill for frontier AI safety. The proposal would allow the government to seek restrictions on a model’s release or use only if it poses a foreseeable and imminent risk of more than $1 billion in damages or at least 50 deaths or serious injuries, including risks involving biological weapons, loss of developer control or cyberattacks. The draft would also require regular independent evaluations of frontier models and place some state-level AI safety rules under a federal framework. — link

Highlight Clip: Vitalik Shares His AI Learning Method: Restate It First, Then Let the Model Correct You Vitalik Shares His AI Learning Method: Restate It First, Then Let the Model Correct You Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said in an October 9 interview with Balaji Srinivasan at the Network State Conference 2026 that talking directly to AI has become an effective way for him to learn difficult subjects. Vitalik said that simply asking AI a question and reading the answer can easily create the illusion of understanding. Instead, he keeps asking questions, then explains the topic again in his own words and asks the model to check whether his understanding is correct. He also asks AI to give him multiple-choice or calculation-based questions so he can verify that he truly understands the material rather than just thinking he does. — link

Qubic Attack Drains 1,404 Wallets of Approximately 2.94 Trillion QU, With 87.1% of Stolen Funds Frozen Layer 1 network Qubic said in a post that between 23:42 UTC on October 17 and 01:26 UTC on October 18, an attacker exploited insufficient randomness in certain wallet seeds to compromise 1,404 wallets and drain approximately 2.94 trillion QU. The vulnerability originated in the seed-generation mechanism, not the Qubic protocol itself. Qubic halted network transactions at tick 85,371,949. Some 87.1% of the stolen funds remain on the network and are frozen, while the remaining 12.9% was transferred to MEXC, where the receiving account has also been frozen. Other exchanges have suspended QUBIC deposits and withdrawals. Qubic fixed the seed-generation issue in version 4.26.4, and any further resolution will be determined by the Computor quorum under the network’s rules. — link
